objects: phased-in source permanent with one typed printed Renown instance
player dealt positive combat damage by that source
events: one ordinary trigger per qualifying Renown instance
state_reads: source creature type in the damage snapshot
current renowned designation at trigger creation and resolution
timing: the not-renowned intervening condition is checked at trigger creation and again at resolution
choices: same-controller trigger ordering uses the ordinary trigger continuation
represented counter-replacement ordering remains scoped to the affected permanent controller
apnap: simultaneous Renown occurrences use ordinary trigger placement
layers: the ability must remain a current typed ability fragment when the final damage event is dispatched
replacement_effects: damage replacement and prevention finish before trigger discovery
counter quantity replacements finish before the renowned designation is applied
copy: the renowned designation is not copied
granted or copied Renown requires separately trusted typed ability propagation
control_change: the trigger controller is frozen at creation while the same source object may later change control
zone_change: a source that leaves and returns is a new logical object, is no longer renowned, and cannot receive the old trigger result
source_leaves: a source that leaves or phases out before resolution causes the intervening condition to fail

variants: redirected combat damage to the source controller
rulings: Topan Freeblade — 2015-06-22 — Renown does not trigger for combat damage to a planeswalker or creature, or for noncombat damage to a player.
Topan Freeblade — 2015-06-22 — Redirected combat damage dealt to the source's controller still triggers Renown.

implementation.component: quorune.renown, quorune.permanent_designations, typed damage-result trigger dispatch, and the canonical counter-placement transaction

known_blockers: becomes-renowned listeners remain separate compiler families
conditional renowned-matters static and triggered abilities remain separate residuals
granted, copied, lost, and face-down Renown requires trusted typed ability propagation
trigger-doubling policies remain outside this bounded capability
aggregate combat damage, counter placement, and triggered abilities remain incomplete
